name: Imperial Colosseum
description: A corrupted empire built on the ruins of heroism. This is where Nike Prime was born — beneath the Colosseum in a secret laboratory. The most lore-critical dimension in the game. Freeing Gladiator Nike unlocks the Scholar Bunker containing the truth of Nike Prime's missing empathy core.

atmosphere.visual: Roman architecture, gladiatorial arenas, senate halls, underground bunker
atmosphere.mood: Grand but hollow. Glory built on corruption.
atmosphere.danger: Political manipulation, gladiatorial combat, ancient automated defenses

charles.name: Colosseum Charles
charles.title: The Senator
charles.description: Trained Cassius, watched him fall. Now navigates the corrupted political landscape to protect what remains.
charles.wisdom: Power without connection is just ambition
charles.backstory: Once the greatest teacher in the Colosseum. His best student Cassius betrayed everything for Nolem's power. That failure defines him.

legendaryNike.name: Gladiator Nike
legendaryNike.title: The Eternal Champion
legendaryNike.description: Leader and General of the Five Champions during Comic Book 1. His identity has collapsed entirely into combat — fighting is all he knows, all he remembers.
legendaryNike.corruptionReason: Identity beyond purpose — fighting is all he has left
legendaryNike.freedBy: Reminding him that a general fights to protect, not to prove

harbinger.name: Cassius
harbinger.title: The Fallen Student
harbinger.corruptionReason: Colosseum Charles's best student. Ambition outgrew bonds. Sacrificed every relationship for power.
harbinger.description: Brilliant, charismatic, driven — but hollow. The tragedy: he was talented enough to be great without Nolem. Still craves his teacher's approval.

act2Legendaries.name: Dr Caleb Nike
act2Legendaries.description: Still running experiments after millennia. Cultivates corruption in himself to study it.

act2Legendaries.name: Professor Nike
act2Legendaries.description: Still reading, cataloging, unable to stop. Wields information as a weapon.

act2Legendaries.name: Satoshi Nike
act2Legendaries.description: Maintains the bunker's computing arrays. His perfect systems turn against intruders.

act2Legendaries.name: Corey Hort Nike
act2Legendaries.description: Guards the oldest secrets. Attacks to share his burden of ancient knowledge.

act2Legendaries.name: Guthix Nike
act2Legendaries.description: Maintains a perfect balance of dimensional frequencies that's slowly killing him.

scholarBunker.description: The underground laboratory beneath the Colosseum where Nike Prime was created during Comic Book 1. Contains the empty growth tank, Nike Prime's design documents, and the truth of the missing empathy core.
scholarBunker.revealContent: All five Scholars together reveal: Nike Prime was 99% complete, the empathy core was never installed, 5,555 bonds are needed to complete him.

locations.name: The Gates
locations.description: Grand entrance to the corrupted empire

locations.name: Champion's Cells
locations.description: Where gladiators are kept before combat

locations.name: The Scholar Bunker
locations.description: Underground lab — Nike Prime's birthplace. Contains five Scholar Legendaries.

dimensionalAnchor.name: Champion's Laurel
dimensionalAnchor.description: A crown of victory worn by one who finally chose freedom over glory.
dimensionalAnchor.obtainedFrom: Gladiator Nike — granted on his defeat — both resolutions count, whether he is freed from corruption or put down

primeEraConnection.role: THE ground zero. Gladiator Nike's home dimension AND base of operations for the entire Nike Prime Project. The growth chamber, the battle, everything happened here.
